change.title: Content update: rule 0291 for template T4

verdict.headline: rule-0291 for template T4 causes content-interpreter to exit with code 3 - rule defines only f01/f13 criteria but interpreter needs all input slots supplied
verdict.cause: The candidate experiment (with rule-0291) produced content-interpreter exit_code 3 with log message: "rule rule-0291 read an input slot that does not exist (12 inputs supplied)". The baseline produced exit_code 0. The rule defines criteria only for f01 and f13, while the interpreter was supplied 12 inputs; the missing criteria for the other input slots caused the fatal error.

limitations: Reviewer (nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b) flagged: "log message: 'rule rule-0291 read an input slot that does not exist (12 inputs supplied)'": unsupported: The experiments do not include log messages; only metrics are shown. No evidence of that exact log message.

Reviewer (nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b) flagged: "the interpreter was supplied 12 inputs": unsupported: The experiments show '12 inputs supplied' only in the unsupported log message claim; no metric or fact states the number of inputs supplied.
No test was run with the expanded rule to confirm exit_code returns to 0; the exact number and names of the missing input slot criteria (f02-f12
f14+) were not inspected from the interpreter schema.

mitigation.text: Add criteria entries for the remaining input slots (beyond f01 and f13) to rule-0291.json so the rule supplies all necessary criteria for the 12 inputs the interpreter expects. This would align the rule's criteria coverage with the interpreter's input supply and should prevent the "read an input slot that does not exist" fatal error.

hypotheses.claim: The content-interpreter will exit with non-zero exit code (fatal error) when rule-0291 is evaluated because it requires 12 input slots but the rule only defines criteria for f01 and f13, leaving 10 input slots unfulfilled.
hypotheses.mechanism: The rule-0291 defines criteria only for fields f01 and f13, but the content-interpreter expects 12 input slots to be supplied. When the rule is evaluated against incoming events, it reads an input slot that does not exist, causing the interpreter to stop with exit code 3.

hypotheses.claim: The candidate experiment (with rule-0291) causes the content-interpreter to exit with code 3 (fatal error), while the baseline exits with code 0. The interpreter log indicates: "rule rule-0291 read an input slot that does not exist (12 inputs supplied)".
hypotheses.mechanism: The content-interpreter supplied 12 inputs during rule-0291 evaluation, but the rule only defines criteria for fields f01 and f13. When the interpreter attempted to read input slots not covered by the rule's criteria, it encountered a missing slot and stopped with exit code 3.

issues.statement: Add criteria for the 10 missing input slots to rule-0291.json so all 12 required input slots are supplied

issues.statement: Add criteria for the 10 missing input slots to rule-0291.json so all 12 required input slots are supplied. The rule currently defines criteria only for f01 and f13; the remaining 10 fields (f02-f12, f14+ if applicable) need criteria entries matching the interpreter's expected input schema.
issues.problem: mitigation would not avoid the failure: The mitigation assumes the interpreter requires exactly 12 input slots and that the failure is due to missing criteria for 10 of them. The evidence does not confirm the interpreter's input schema size or that exit code 3 is caused by missing criteria. Therefore we cannot conclude that adding 10 criteria entries would avoid the failure.
